first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: teal stadium seating
entities.identification: The teal seating area in the center to lower part of the frame at the beginning of the clip, densely arranged in stepped tiers and adjacent to the gray passageway and light-colored railing.

entities.name: passageway floor
entities.identification: The dark passageway surface visible between the railings and support structures in the final segment, illuminated by purple light.

entities.name: purple-orange passageway light fixture
entities.identification: The purple linear light sources and warm orange-yellow point light sources around the passageway.

entities.name: illuminated direction marker
entities.identification: Groups of illuminated bright segments appearing along the route; pink-purple short bars and a partially visible yellow bright angled shape at the right edge are visible at the beginning, while cyan-white and pink-purple bright shapes are visible in the final segment.
